s.t: Sophia Kennedy recorded ‘Being Special’ and the rest of her debut with Mense Reents over almost a year, in Die Goldenen Zitronen’s dusty basement studio near Hamburg’s fish market.
s.src: Deutschlandfunk: Debütalbum von Sophia Kennedy – Popmusik als Psychotherapie (Andi Hörmann, 13 May 2017); saved as pages/dlf.txt
s.q: Hamburg, Nähe Fischmarkt. Backsteinbau, Hinterhof. Eine vergitterte Tür zum düster staubigen Kellerstudio der "Goldenen Zitronen": Hier hat Sophia Kennedy fast ein Jahr an ihrem Album gebastelt - nicht alleine: "Ich bin Mense Reents und ich habe mit Sophia das Album zusammen aufgenommen.

s.t: On 8 March 2018 Sophia Kennedy sang ‘Being Special’ live on ZDFneo’s comedy show Neo Magazin Royale, with the Rundfunk-Tanzorchester Ehrenfeld.
s.src: Neo Magazin Royale/Episodenliste (German Wikipedia); saved as pages/NMR_Episodenliste.wikitext

s.t: Ten months after the album, Pampa Records gave ‘Being Special’ its own limited 10-inch, backed with Sophia Kennedy’s cover of Nico’s ‘Afraid’ and an unreleased song, ‘Apple in the Basket’.
s.src: Pampa Records: PAMPA029 – Being Special; saved as pages/pampa029.txt
s.q: Released: 2018-02-16 … Limited 10 Inch Vinyl containing „Being Special“, a beautiful cover version of „Nico“ and a unrelesed track on the flip side. The April 2017 release of avant pop artist Sophia Kennedy’s self-titled album … “Afraid”, originally written by the all time underground legend Nico … “Apple In The Basket”

s.t: Katharina Duve, an experimental filmmaker whose work has shown at Tate Modern and who has worked with Deichkind since 2012, directed and edited Sophia Kennedy’s video for it.
s.src: Katharina Duve: Info; saved as pages/duveinfo.txt
s.q: Her work was shown in international group exhibitions like „Kaputt“, Tate Modern, London … a creative co-worker of the German music band Deichkind (since 2012) … 2017 Being Special – Sophia Kennedy music video, 3.17min director, editing: Katharina Duve

f.t: Playing a wine fair to 500 drunk people, she was booed by some men; when a woman asked where the DJ was, she threw her water in the woman’s face.
f.src: SCHIRN MAG: Belting it out from time to time (Teresa Köster, 23 Aug 2017); saved as pages/schirn.txt
f.q: I was playing at a wine fair, in front of 500 drunk people who had no interest at all in a concert and stared at me as though I came from another planet. A group of men started booing me and a woman asked where the DJ was so I just threw my water in her face.

f.t: As a girl she sang to the bushes, pretending they were her audience; in 2017 she said: “In five years, maybe I’ll be a huge star. But right now nobody cares.”
f.src: The Cut: Sophia Kennedy Made the Best Pop Record You’ve Probably Never Heard Of (Dayna Evans, 23 June 2017); saved as pages/cut.txt
f.q: When she was young, Kennedy used to “sing to the bushes,” pretending they were her audience … “We’ll see. In five years, maybe I’ll be a huge star. But right now nobody cares.”

f.t: When Pitchfork heard loneliness and homesickness in her debut, she pushed back: “I didn’t feel lonely or depressed when doing the album. I didn’t want to be that specific.”
f.src: The Cut (Dayna Evans, 23 June 2017); saved as pages/cut.txt
f.q: But contrary to Pitchfork’s review, which insinuated a theme of loneliness and homesickness, Kennedy insists that she didn’t want the record to have too much of herself in it. “I didn’t feel lonely or depressed when doing the album. I didn’t want to be that specific.”

f.t: In 2018 she sang, partly in German, on two tracks of DJ Koze’s album Knock Knock: ‘Drone Me Up, Flashy’ and ‘This Is My Rock’.
f.src: Sophia Kennedy (German Wikipedia); saved as pages/de_Sophia_Kennedy.wikitext
f.q: 2018 war Kennedy zudem auf den Stücken Drone Me Up, Flashy und This Is My Rock von DJ Kozes Album Knock Knock zu hören, in denen sie auch auf Deutsch singt.

f.t: Making her debut, she studied Kanye West’s songs: “He puts in wild things and glues parts together and his songs have a very weird structure that I really like.”
f.src: The Cut (Dayna Evans, 23 June 2017); saved as pages/cut.txt
f.q: “I paid attention to how Kanye West works and how his songs are put together,” she points out. “He has a very interesting way of structuring and arranging his songs … He puts in wild things and glues parts together and his songs have a very weird structure that I really like.”
